title: tinytopia - a live multiplayer world decorating game :)
author: Man_Get_Lost
selftext:
Hi, all!



I've been working on this for a couple of months on and off, and I think I can finally share.



[https://tinytopia.io](https://tinytopia.io)



tinytopia is a live multiplayer world decorating game - find a little corner in the world, and claim space as your own by placing decorations and building a cute little spot for the animal villagers.



Originally I had made this as just a fun experiment with open map data, and decided it would be fun to turn it into an incremental game. Placing decorations creates a 'build area' that requires upkeep.



At the moment, it's quite simple in terms of its 'gameplay' -- but it isn't meant to be anything crazy, just a fun little experiment more than anything. I have ideas to expand on the core gameplay, but since it's in a playable state right now, I figured people might enjoy tinkering with it.



No need to create an account - you can play as a Guest, but your progress doesn't save.

Welcome any feedback!

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Man_Get_Lost could you add more about how AI fit into your development process? Just mentioning that AI was used doesn't cut it. Under Rule 4, promotional posts need to contribute something by discussing how the game was actually made. Otherwise the sub gets buried in ads. If there's no update, this post may be removed.

replies.author: Man_Get_Lost
replies.body: Hi Mods, thank you and apologies - I've added some more context which is hopefully sufficient!
